# Nayab — Free AI Chat powered by offLLama

> Nayab is a lightweight, privacy-first AI chat assistant. Free tier powered by offLLama, a self-hosted inference engine. Paid plan available via Gumroad.

## About

Nayab is a ChatGPT-style web app built to showcase offLLama — an open-source library for running llama.cpp inference on any Node.js host.

URL: https://chat.zulqurnainj.com
Also available at: https://zulqurnainj.com/chat
Built by: Zulqurnain Haider (https://zulqurnainj.com)

## Features

- Streaming AI responses
- File upload support (PDF, TXT, RTF, PNG, JPG — 1 MB max)
- Text to speech (browser-native)
- Optional web search via DuckDuckGo
- Model selection for paid users
- Privacy-first: no persistent storage of chats or files
- Rate limited: 1 request per 5 seconds (fair use)

## Plans

Free: Self-hosted offLLama model (Qwen 2.5)
Paid: $10/month via Gumroad — unlocks GPT-4o, Claude, and other models
